# Agent Terminal

> Agent Terminal is a free, open-source terminal workspace built around AI coding agents. It organizes terminal tabs by project and shows agent activity and live process, Git, port, and working-directory context.

Agent Terminal is stable on macOS 13 or later with Zsh. Experimental Linux x86-64 builds are available as AppImage, Debian and RPM packages. Windows is untested. The project is MIT-licensed.

## Documentation

- [Documentation](https://agent-terminal.org/docs): Installation, projects, agent integrations, status bar, Agent Usage limits, mobile companion, shortcuts, platforms, and contributing.
- [Downloads](https://agent-terminal.org/downloads): Latest stable macOS and Linux packages from GitHub.
- [Agent integrations](https://agent-terminal.org/agents): Support status, launch commands, and setup links for coding agents.
- [Changelog](https://agent-terminal.org/changelog): Published release notes from GitHub.
- [Privacy policy](https://agent-terminal.org/privacy): What the desktop app and the mobile companions do and do not send off your device.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/DaniAkash/agent-terminal): Source code, README, issues, and releases.
- [Agent Usage limits](https://github.com/DaniAkash/agent-terminal/blob/main/docs/agent-usage.md): Provider quota sources, settings, and troubleshooting.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/DaniAkash/agent-terminal/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Development setup and adding agent integrations.

## Installation

Install the macOS application with Homebrew:

```sh
brew install --cask daniakash/tap/agent-terminal
```

Download macOS and experimental Linux packages from the [downloads page](https://agent-terminal.org/downloads) or [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/DaniAkash/agent-terminal/releases).

## Agent support

Claude Code, Codex CLI, and opencode are supported. Amp, Kilo Code, Kimi CLI, and Mastra are experimental. Cursor, GitHub Copilot CLI, Factory Droid, and Qoder are planned. Install an agent separately and launch it in an Agent Terminal tab.
